cues.en: I mentioned in the previous section that we are going to take an experimental approach to understanding deep learning.
cues.zh: 上一節提過，我們要用實驗的方式理解深度學習。

cues.en: That means that we are going to be running lots of experiments.
cues.zh: 這表示會做很多實驗。

cues.en: And when running experiments, one of the things that we need to do is determine whether one particular
cues.zh: 做實驗時，其中一件必須做的事，是判斷某個，

cues.en: model, architecture or set of meta parameters is better than a different architecture or a different set of meta parameters.
cues.zh: 模型、架構或一組超參數，是否比另一個架構或另一組超參數更好。

cues.en: So how do we determine whether our experiment was successful?
cues.zh: 要怎麼判斷實驗是否成功？

cues.en: How do we determine whether one model architecture is significantly better than another?
cues.zh: 要怎麼判斷，一種模型架構是否顯著優於另一種？

cues.en: So the answer to that question is a t test.
cues.zh: 答案是 t 檢定。

cues.en: We are going to be performing t tests.
cues.zh: 我們會執行 t 檢定。

cues.en: So what is a t test?
cues.zh: 什麼是 t 檢定？

cues.en: A t test is a way to determine whether data drawn from one distribution is significantly different from data drawn from another distribution or another sample.
cues.zh: t 檢定用來判斷，從一個分布抽出的資料，和另一個分布或另一個樣本的資料，是否有顯著差異。

cues.en: So imagine each of these little circles here corresponds to the accuracy of a model with architecture A, and this is model architecture B.
cues.zh: 假設這裡每個小圓點，代表架構 A 的模型準確率，而這邊是架構 B。

cues.en: So we have a bunch of prediction or categorization accuracies here and here.
cues.zh: 兩邊都有一組預測或分類準確率。

cues.en: And we want to know whether, you know, model A is significantly better than model B, which would
cues.zh: 我們想知道，模型 A 是否顯著優於模型 B，

cues.en: mean that the accuracies for model A are significantly higher than the accuracies for model B.
cues.zh: 也就是模型 A 的準確率，是否顯著高於模型 B。

cues.en: And the way that we test this is using a t test.
cues.zh: 測試的方法就是 t 檢定。

cues.en: So h a here corresponds to stands for the alternative hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這裡的 H_a 代表對立假設。

cues.en: So the hypothesis is that this model is significantly different from this model.
cues.zh: 假設是，這個模型和另一個模型顯著不同。

cues.en: So this is the alternative hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這就是對立假設。

cues.en: And we evaluate the alternative hypothesis relative to what's called a null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 評估對立假設時，會拿它和所謂虛無假設比較。

cues.en: It's often written down as h sub zero for h naught or h null.
cues.zh: 通常寫成 H_0，讀作 H-naught 或 H-null。

cues.en: So this is the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這就是虛無假設。

cues.en: The null hypothesis states that the two models perform equally well, so that means that we could mix
cues.zh: 虛無假設認為，兩個模型表現一樣好，所以可以把，

cues.en: up all of the accuracies from the two models, and it doesn't change the average accuracy from model
cues.zh: 兩個模型的所有準確率混在一起，也不會改變，

cues.en: from this collection versus this collection, because the two models perform equally well.
cues.zh: 這組和那組的平均準確率，因為兩個模型表現相同。

cues.en: So the goal of the T test is to provide evidence against the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: t 檢定的目標，是提供反對虛無假設的證據。

cues.en: And if there is enough evidence strong enough evidence against the null hypothesis, then we go with
cues.zh: 如果有足夠、夠強的證據反對虛無假設，就採用，

cues.en: the alternative hypothesis, which would be that this model is significantly better than this model.
cues.zh: 對立假設，也就是這個模型顯著優於另一個模型。

cues.en: And that's how we distinguish between different kinds of models and their performance on data sets.
cues.zh: 這就是區分不同模型及其資料集表現的方式。

cues.en: By the way, it's also possible to use a t test for one set of model performance data against some arbitrary null value, for example, 50% accuracy.
cues.zh: 順便說，也可以把一組模型表現，和任意虛無值做 t 檢定，例如百分之五十的準確率。

cues.en: Let's say if the model is doing, you know, two two alternative choice discrimination than 50% would be would correspond to accuracy of chance.
cues.zh: 如果模型做的是二選一辨識，百分之五十就對應隨機猜測的準確率。

cues.en: So we can test whether the model is doing significantly better than chance level of 50%.
cues.zh: 所以，可以測試模型是否顯著優於百分之五十的猜測水準。

cues.en: However, in this course, we are mostly going to be using the t test to compare different model architectures or different model parameters directly against each other, like this.
cues.zh: 不過，這門課主要會用 t 檢定，直接比較不同架構或不同參數的模型，就像這樣。

cues.en: So here is the basic formula for the t test.
cues.zh: 這是 t 檢定的基本公式。

cues.en: The t test gives us one single value.
cues.zh: t 檢定會給我們一個數值。

cues.en: That's the t value.
cues.zh: 也就是 t 值。

cues.en: And it's governed by this pretty simple equation.
cues.zh: 它由這個相當簡單的式子決定。

cues.en: So we have the mean of x minus the mean of y divided by s which corresponds to the standard deviation itself normalized by the square root of n and n.
cues.zh: x 的平均數減掉 y 的平均數，再除以 s；s 對應標準差，並以 n 的平方根正規化，而 n，

cues.en: Here corresponds to the number of times that we repeat the model.
cues.zh: 代表重複執行模型的次數。

cues.en: So if we rerun the model let's say 20 times then this would be the square root of 20.
cues.zh: 如果重新執行二十次，這裡就是二十的平方根。

cues.en: Now don't worry too much about the math because we are going to be we're going to allow SciPy, a Python library to implement to compute the t value for us.
cues.zh: 不用太擔心數學，因為會讓 Python 程式庫 SciPy，替我們計算 t 值。

cues.en: What I want you to remember.
cues.zh: 我希望你記住的，

cues.en: The important thing to remember here is what this formula means.
cues.zh: 重點是這個公式的意義。

cues.en: So the t test.
cues.zh: 也就是 t 檢定。

cues.en: The t value is the difference of the means divided by the standard deviations.
cues.zh: t 值是平均數的差，除以標準差。

cues.en: All.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: You just have to remember this concept.
cues.zh: 只要記住這個概念。

cues.en: The difference of the means divided by or normalized by the standard deviations.
cues.zh: 平均數之差，除以，或者說以標準差正規化。

cues.en: That gives us a t value.
cues.zh: 就得到 t 值。

cues.en: And then what do we do with this t value.
cues.zh: 接著，拿這個 t 值做什麼？

cues.en: Well we have to evaluate this t value relative to a distribution of t values that we would expect under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 要把它和虛無假設成立時，預期會得到的 t 值分布比較。

cues.en: Again the null hypothesis is that there are no differences between the two different model architectures.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，虛無假設是，兩種模型架構之間沒有差異。

cues.en: So the two model architectures are the same.
cues.zh: 所以兩種模型架構相同。

cues.en: And any differences we might observe.
cues.zh: 任何觀察到的差別，

cues.en: Any minor differences between the two models in terms of their performance is not actually due to the models, it's actually just due to random sampling variability.
cues.zh: 也就是兩個模型表現上的微小差異，並不是來自模型，而只是隨機抽樣變異。

cues.en: So here you see again this concept of sampling variability and randomness appearing.
cues.zh: 所以，再次看到抽樣變異與隨機性的概念。

cues.en: So given random sampling variability you would expect that the model accuracies would differ a little bit just by random chance.
cues.zh: 由於隨機抽樣變異，模型準確率可能只是碰巧有一點差異。

cues.en: And so what you see here is a t distribution a distribution of t statistic values that we expect under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這裡看到的是 t 分布，也就是虛無假設成立時，預期的 t 統計量分布。

cues.en: This is not something that we compute.
cues.zh: 這不是我們自己計算出來的。

cues.en: This is something we analytically derive from a formula.
cues.zh: 而是從公式解析推導出來。

cues.en: Of course SciPy implements that.
cues.zh: 當然，SciPy 已經實作。

cues.en: So SciPy is taking care of the details of this for us.
cues.zh: 所以，SciPy 會替我們處理細節。

cues.en: So then we compute our observed t value in the real data.
cues.zh: 接著，用真實資料算出觀察到的 t 值。

cues.en: These are the real data that we have measured in our deep learning models.
cues.zh: 也就是深度學習模型實際測量到的資料。

cues.en: And we compare this value.
cues.zh: 把這個值拿來比較。

cues.en: Let's say this t value is 1.5.
cues.zh: 假設 t 值是一點五。

cues.en: We compare this value against a statistical significance threshold.
cues.zh: 把它和統計顯著性的門檻比較。

cues.en: And this threshold comes from specifying a p value threshold of, for example, 0.05.
cues.zh: 這個門檻來自指定 p 值門檻，例如零點零五。

cues.en: So 0.05 is a pretty typical value.
cues.zh: 零點零五是很常見的數值。

cues.en: 0.05 means that there is a 5% chance that we observed a statistic of this size, given these data purely
cues.zh: 零點零五表示，在這些資料下，純粹因為偶然，觀察到這種大小統計量的機會是百分之五，

cues.en: by chance, just by random sampling variability.
cues.zh: 也就是只由隨機抽樣變異造成。

cues.en: So in this particular example, we have a t value of 1.5.
cues.zh: 在這個特定例子裡，t 值是一點五。

cues.en: And that is below the threshold.
cues.zh: 低於門檻。

cues.en: So below the significance threshold.
cues.zh: 也就是低於顯著性門檻。

cues.en: So the p value is 0.065.
cues.zh: 所以 p 值是零點零六五。

cues.en: And what does this mean.
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: Well this means that our two different models are two different deep learning model architectures actually
cues.zh: 表示我們的兩種模型，也就是兩種深度學習模型架構，

cues.en: gave the same performance, which means that the models perform equally well.
cues.zh: 其實得到相同表現，兩個模型表現一樣好。

cues.en: There is no real significant meaningful difference between the two models in terms of how they perform on a given data set.
cues.zh: 它們在特定資料集上的表現，沒有真正顯著、有意義的差異。

cues.en: Now, if the models were more different from each other, then the T value would be larger, which means
cues.zh: 如果兩個模型更不一樣，t 值就會更大，表示，

cues.en: that this yellow arrow here would be to the right of this significance threshold.
cues.zh: 這個黃色箭頭，會在顯著性門檻的右邊。

cues.en: This corresponding p value would be below 0.05.
cues.zh: 對應的 p 值會低於零點零五。

cues.en: And then we would interpret that result as saying that one model is significantly better.
cues.zh: 這時，就會把結果解讀為，一個模型顯著優於另一個。

cues.en: It has better higher accuracy than the other models.
cues.zh: 它的準確率比另一個模型更高。

cues.en: So therefore we should prefer the model that has higher accuracy.
cues.zh: 因此，應該偏好準確率較高的模型。
